Model limits & sources

Configurations come from PubChem, with the Lr configuration corrected using NIST. Elements 104–118 are marked as theoretical or experimentally limited; oxidation states may include predictions. Missing values are labelled. No live quantum-chemistry calculations are performed.

Shells are counted by principal quantum number. For d/f elements, outermost-shell electrons are not the total valence count. Orbital diagrams show real spherical-harmonic angular shapes, omitting radial nodes, size, relativistic effects and spin–orbit coupling. Dots are not electron positions or precise probability densities.

Masses are in u. Isotope reference masses are labelled and are not natural isotope averages. The compound collection is limited; ionic diagrams are not unit cells. Lewis drawings support the included single-center examples.

Sources:PubChem elements · NIST lawrencium · RSC elements
